    "App/UI_UX_SPEC.md and App/BUSINESS_RULES.md: approved Botanist behavior requires reviewed Journey-eligible botanical entries, localized greeting/empty state, separate details and distinct discovery/save/equip transitions. Empty eligibility is valid.",
    "src/features/healthclues/RegionMapScene.tsx: PASS for source wiring. Both playable regions define the Botanist artwork reference and garden approach. Successful route completion sets nearby; the Talk banner requires an active nearby NPC and opens the station through onLandmark. This establishes client behavior in source, not browser execution or server proximity enforcement.",
    "src/features/healthclues/RegionMapScene.tsx and src/components/healthclues/HealthCluesLocaleProvider.tsx: PASS for localization hooks. Botanist name, greeting, approach label and Talk use text(), which delegates to the translation function. Actual dictionary entries were not supplied; translation correctness remains UNVERIFIED.",
    "src/features/healthclues/WorldAdventureScene.tsx: PASS for excluding generic PersonalizedSuggestions from the nutrition panel. The botanical station is delegated to an imported component whose implementation was not supplied; reviewed-content filtering, details, empty-state copy and Save/Equip controls cannot be corroborated.",
    "src/app/api/healthclues/npc-chat/route.ts: source requires authentication, confirmed email, World ownership, provider configuration and external-processing consent; retrieval excludes test-fixture reviewers and demo-only provenance. Botanist retrieval uses the broader food domain, with no explicit Journey-topic filter or locale input. This endpoint is separate from the authored Talk greeting; its connection to the station and live integration remain UNVERIFIED.",
    "scripts/test-healthclues-region-layout.mjs: supplied assertions cover shared anchors and connected paths, not Botanist visuals, translations or station content. NPC approach positions in src/features/healthclues/RegionMapScene.tsx subtract 112 world units from their anchors, whereas this test checks the anchors themselves; it does not directly validate the actual NPC approaches.",
    "scripts/run-healthclues-game-e2e.mjs: supplied harness uses synthetic catalog rows, signed test identities, mocked Auth/email handling and a local database path. Its browser sequence expects older onboarding and World UI. No execution output was supplied; it establishes neither current Botanist acceptance nor live provider integration.",
    "App/CURRENT_STATE.md, App/ACCEPTANCE_TESTS.md and App/reports/HEALTHCLUES_MASTER_PROMPT_17_ACCEPTANCE.md: localized Talk/empty-state visual PASS and fixture browser success are reported, but screenshots, raw run artifacts and the relevant current browser harness were not supplied. These claims remain report-only for this audit. The report explicitly leaves eligible botanical Save/Equip unverified.",
    "App/reports/HEALTHCLUES_MASTER_PROMPT_17_ACCEPTANCE.md: historical matrices retain NOT STARTED/NOT RUN statements alongside later implementation and fixture-PASS sections. Later sections also supersede earlier Gemini billing/schema failures with a reported successful synthetic inference. These are chronological checkpoints, not one consistent current acceptance matrix; none proves live Botanist chat.",
    "App/CURRENT_STATE.md: audit input is pinned to the supplied owner-approved SHA-256 ea2cfc73853f7a43e75adad8959ccd18c82ff3654c1a2ec9b0d3da73926c99f8. No live files, hashes or watcher state were inspected."
  ],
  "knownLimitations": [
    "Visual acceptance remains UNVERIFIED: no reviewable screenshot with viewport dimensions was supplied for inspection.",
    "Botanist station implementation, translation dictionary, CSS, artwork bytes and catalog/equipment API implementations were not supplied.",
    "The absence of reviewed eligible botanical content is reported, not independently established from catalog data.",
    "Report-described browser runs and builds were not independently reproduced; fixtures do not establish live AI quality or production readiness.",
    "Live input changes cannot be detected in this tools-free audit."
  ],
  "blockers": [
    "Missing screenshots prevent visual verification.",
    "Missing station source, current focused test source and execution artifacts prevent complete content/localization/interaction corroboration.",
    "Reported lack of reviewed eligible botanical content blocks item-card Save/Equip acceptance, while permitting an honest empty state."
  ],
  "nextSuggestedSteps": [
    "Supply current Botanist station, translation and filtering/API evidence plus focused test results; verify reviewed botanical eligibility, exclusion of TEST ONLY/unrelated nutrition rows and disabled or absent Save/Equip controls when empty.",
    "Supply inspectable EN/VI Botanist Talk and empty-state screenshots at 1440×900 and 390×844, tied to the audited source/build.",
    "When a genuinely reviewed Journey-eligible botanical item is available, exercise details, Collection save and explicit NPC-origin equipment separately; verify reload and account isolation without relabeling fixtures.",
